edition: Laporan Kinerja Kementerian Komunikasi dan Digital 2025
issuer: Kementerian Komunikasi dan Digital Republik Indonesia
provenance: Digitized directly from uploaded original PDF; page numbers in this data refer to PDF page positions matching printed annual report folio for pages 10+. This is an offline 2025 retrospective with some earlier baselines and 2029 projections.
caveats: Do not equate ~370 MW total data-center capacity in 2025 with dedicated GPU/AI capacity, nor projected 1,410 MW 2029 demand with signed financing or installed capacity.
2024 ITDN 55.52 reused as 2025 performance proxy with an asterisk in the official report; not a true 2025 measurement.
The PDF's 2025 Table 3.9 PDNS RAM row sum is 171,774 while the reported total is 171,773; storage row sum 18,337,876 GB versus reported total 18,337,877 GB. Do not silently reconcile.
Table 3.26 SATRIA gateway cities are sourced, but no official point coordinates are provided in the report; do not create fabricated GPS pins.
Figure 3.25 SPLP numerator/denominator is a grouping of province/regency/city governments by geographical province; it is not exclusively provincial agency adoption.
2025 4G population footprint and 5G settlement-area footprint have DIFFERENT denominators.
SATRIA-1 gateway IP HUB capacity is distinct from provisioned IP transit or actual throughput.
Palapa Ring East microwave Gbps is converted from 5,500/5,050 Mbps solely for visualization; its 2025 reported 91.81% utilization is kept.

Figure 3.25 provincial SPLP displayed labels sum to 371 connected of 542 available units, but the headline says 378 of 546 local governments. Preserve printed provincial fractions and headline separately without forcing a reconciliation.
Digital-space content blocking statistics count access-block actions, not cybersecurity incidents or confirmed breaches. Privacy (PDP) potential findings are not adjudicated violations.
